Optimal.Notes: This profile trades a little battery life for slightly better image clarity via medium textures and a higher internal render resolution; the 30 fps cap with FSR upscaling is the most realistic stable target on Deck for this UE5 title. Drop textures back to Low and reduce resolution scale if frametimes spike in busy firefights.

profiles.Summary: Bodycam is a demanding Unreal Engine 5 tactical multiplayer FPS whose minimum GPU requirements (RX 5700 / RTX 2070) far exceed the Steam Deck's RDNA 2 GPU, making stable framerates very challenging; expect significant compromises in settings and resolution to reach playable performance. No Deck-specific reports exist yet, and the game is Steam Deck Unsupported, so online connectivity and anti-cheat compatibility should be verified on first launch.

Verify the game launches online before investing time in tuning.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Running at full 15 W TDP with the GPU pinned at max clock and the refresh rate locked to 40 Hz gives the best chance of hitting a locked 40 fps; realistically expect dips to 30 in dense combat given the engine's demands far exceed Deck hardware. This will drain the battery quickly and the device will run warm.

Optimal.Notes: A locked 40 fps at 40 Hz gives the smoothest feel the Deck can reliably sustain in this UE5 title; FSR upscaling from 1024x640 recovers sharpness lost from the lower render resolution. Keep an eye on GPU temperature — if the fan ramps aggressively, drop TDP to 11 W.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Full 15 W TDP with GPU at maximum clock gives the Deck every resource available; 45 Hz cap prevents tearing and is more achievable than 60 fps given UE5 overhead. Battery life will be short and the fan will be audible — best suited for docked-adjacent or plugged-in play.
